title: U.S. judge says Ethereum has ‘no terms of use,’ clears MIT brothers of $25 million fraud
reason: Federal acquittal in the first criminal MEV prosecution sets a meaningful legal precedent with named parties and a clear ruling.

sources.summary: A federal judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno, ruling that their 2023 trade against Ethereum trading bots involved no lie that anyone relied on, and closing the U.S. government’s first criminal case over the practice known as MEV.

title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO
reason: The first public statement from Jensen Huang since his Nvidia resignation is a major development at the most important AI infrastructure company.

sources.summary: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.
